title.value: AN ACT concerning perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances in firefighting foam and supplementing Title 56 of the Revised Statutes
title.provenance: AN ACT concerning perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances in firefighting foam and supplementing Title 56 of the Revised Statutes.

reference.provenance: AN ACT concerning perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances in firefighting foam and supplementing Title 56 of the Revised Statutes.

status.provenance: BE IT ENACTED by the Senate and General Assembly of the State of New Jersey:

pfas_definition.provenance: Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances or 'PFAS' means substances that include any member of the class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: a. Beginning two years after the effective date of this act, no person shall use, or shall sell, offer for sale, manufacture, or distribute for sale or use in the State any class B firefighting foam containing intentionally added PFAS.

date.provenance: BE IT ENACTED by the Senate and General Assembly of the State of New Jersey:

who.provenance: no person shall use, or shall sell, offer for sale, manufacture, or distribute for sale or use in the State

action.provenance: no person shall use, or shall sell, offer for sale, manufacture, or distribute for sale or use in the State any class B firefighting foam containing intentionally added PFAS.

products.provenance: any class B firefighting foam containing intentionally added PFAS

value: sale, manufacture, distribution, or use of class B firefighting foam for which the inclusion of PFAS is required by federal law or regulation
exceptions.provenance: This act shall not apply to the sale, manufacture, distribution, or use of class B firefighting foam for which the inclusion of PFAS is required by federal law or regulation

intentionally_added.provenance: Intentionally added PFAS means PFAS added to a product or one of the product's components to provide a specific characteristic, appearance, or quality or to perform a specific function.
